info.title: Shift Management API
info.description: API for shift and employee management system

post.description: Creates a new user in the system

items.example: The email has already been taken
The password must be at least 8 characters

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns an access token

extended_token.description: Request a long-lived token (24h instead of 1h)

message.example: Invalid credentials. Please check your email and password.

get.description: Returns current user data and employee profile if it exists

post.description: Revokes current tokens and generates a new one

extended_token.description: Request a long-lived token (24h instead of 1h)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of employees with filtering and sorting options

message.example: Supervisor account is not linked to an employee profile.

post.description: Creates a new employee in the system

items.example: The email field must be a valid email address

message.example: Failed to create employee: Database error

get.description: Retrieves a list of employees under the supervision of the current user

message.example: Your user account is not linked to an employee profile.

get.description: Returns comprehensive employee information including shifts, assignments, replacement requests, bids, clock activity, and audit data based on user permissions

personal.description: Sensitive data visible only to admins and supervisors

upcoming_shifts.description: Shifts for current and next week

assignments.description: Shift assignments for current and next week

audit.description: Security/audit data visible only to admins

message.example: Unauthorized. You do not have permission to view this employee as they belong to a different company.
Unauthorized. You can only view employees you supervise.

put.description: Updates the details of a specific employee

delete.description: Deletes a specific employee by ID

get.description: Retrieves the details of the currently authenticated employee

post.summary: Assign a supervisor to an employee
post.description: Assigns or updates the supervisor for a specific employee

supervisor_id.description: The ID of the supervisor to assign

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of shift configurations. Filtering and sorting options are available.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of items per page

get.summary: Get shift configurations for the supervisor's team
get.description: Retrieves a list of shift configurations for the employees supervised by the authenticated user.

parameters.name: employee_id
parameters.description: Filter by employee ID among supervised employees

200.description: List of shift configurations for supervised employees

404.description: The user is not a supervisor or is not linked to an employee profile

get.summary: Get shift configurations for the current employee
get.description: Retrieves a list of shift configurations specific to the authenticated employee.

200.description: List of shift configurations for the authenticated employee

404.description: The user is not linked to an employee profile

get.summary: Retrieve a specific shift configuration by ID
get.description: Gets the details of a specific shift configuration identified by its ID.

403.description: Forbidden - You do not have permission for this action

put.description: Allows an admin to update an existing shift configuration by ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the shift configuration to update

403.description: Forbidden - You do not have permission for this action

delete.description: Deletes a shift configuration by its ID. Only accessible by admins.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the shift configuration to delete

403.description: Forbidden - You do not have permission for this action

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all shifts. Access is controlled by role: admins see all shifts, supervisors see only their team's shifts, employees can't access this endpoint.

200.description: List of shifts for the authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new shift in the system with validations for overlapping shifts and weekly hour limits.

date_end.description: End date/time (must be after start time)

total_hours.description: Total shift hours (used for weekly limit validation)

message.example: The shift overlaps with other shifts assigned to the employee
You are not authorized to create shifts

get.description: Returns a paginated list of shifts assigned to the authenticated user only. This endpoint is specifically for employees to view their own shifts.

message.example: Your user account is not linked to an employee profile.

get.description: Retrieves the shifts assigned to the employees supervised by the current user (supervisor or administrator).
Retrieves the details of a specific shift by its ID.

put.description: Updates the details of an existing shift with validations for overlapping shifts and weekly hour limits.

date_end.description: End date/time (must be after start time)

total_hours.description: Total shift hours (used for weekly limit validation)

message.example: The shift exceeds the employee's weekly limit of 40 hours.
You are not authorized to update this shift

delete.description: Deletes a shift from the system by its ID.

get.description: Retrieves the current day's shift for the authenticated user

put.description: Registers the clock-in or clock-out time for a shift with location validation

type.description: Type of record: clock in or clock out

timezone.description: The timezone where the employee is located at clock time

403.description: Not authorized to modify this shift

items.example: The type must be clock_on or clock_off

get.description: Allows getting shifts filtered by date range, employees and locations, grouped by day, week or month

parameters.name: view_type
parameters.description: View type to group results: daily, weekly, monthly

parameters.name: user_ids[]
parameters.description: Employee IDs to filter (can be repeated for multiple values)

parameters.name: location_ids[]
parameters.description: Location IDs to filter (can be repeated for multiple values)

200.description: Successfully obtained shifts grouped by view type

get.summary: Get shift history and date summary
get.description: Retrieves the current shift for a specific date, history of the 10 most recent shifts, and date summary with shift counts for a 7-day range (3 days before and 3 days after the specified date)

message.example: Your user account is not linked to an employee profile.

get.description: This endpoint generates shifts for the upcoming fortnight based on predefined shift configurations. Restricted to users with the `admin` or `supervisor` roles.

403.description: Unauthorized access. Only users with `admin` or `supervisor` roles can access this endpoint.

500.description: An error occurred while generating shifts.
